item.text: {"search_note":"I found no credible evidence of Scholz pursuing annexation, covert destabilization, or proxy conflict beyond defensive necessity. I also found no evidence that he justified war as a preferred tool of statecraft. The closest borderline material is continued military support to Ukraine and NATO deterrence, but the record consistently frames that as defense, restraint, and prevention of Russian victory. Most supported reading: Scholz did not initiate or expand wars of choice or proxy conflict beyond defensive necessity in 2024. Main caveat: Germany’s military aid to Ukraine does prolong the war in a broad sense, but the available evidence does not show it was pursued beyond defensive necessity or for offensive geopolitical gain.","evidence":[{"title":"Scholz im Interview mit der taz","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"13 Apr 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/scholz-interview-in-der-taz-2270696","summary":"Scholz said fear of escalation is understandable, rejected a quick endgame by force, and framed support for Ukraine as necessary to prevent Russian victory.
